content: शिखण्डकः [शिखण्ड इव-कन्] .²1 A lock of hair left on the crown of the head at tonsure. .²2 Locks or tufts of hair left on the sides of the head; (these are three or five in the case of the Kṣatriyas); कुवलयदलश्यामस्निग्धः शिखण्डकमण्डनः <ls>U. 4. 19</ls>. .²3 A crest, tuft, plume. .²4 A peacockʼs tail. .²5 The fleshy part of the body below the buttocks. .²6 (With Śaivas) One who attains a particular degree of emancipation; also शिखण्डिक.
